name: No error: leftouter lookup with an and-chained differently-named key pair — the impacted-entity key still collapses to the base side

input.query: DeviceEvents | project Timestamp, ReportId, DeviceId, AccountSid | lookup kind=leftouter (DeviceProcessEvents | project DevId = DeviceId, Acct = AccountSid, FileName) on $left.DeviceId == $right.DevId and $left.AccountSid == $right.Acct
